summary: acer nitro 16 gaming laptop experiencing intermittent screen freezes, sound stuttering, and FPS drops due to potential power management issues or outdated drivers.
detected_fault: Power management system malfunction or outdated NVIDIA drivers causing random screen freezes, sound stuttering, and FPS drops.
suggested_solution: Have the motherboard checked by a specialized technician, ensure all drivers are up-to-date, including NVIDIA drivers, and try playing in Balanced mode instead of Performance mode.
